value.rationale: The source and target are canonical minimal finite models, and the invariant is the full direct homotopy set, not an arbitrary slice. The result quantifies a central finite-model phenomenon: direct maps realize only zero and the four signed coordinate homology classes even though the classical set \(H^1(T^2;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z^2\) is infinite. The exact split into a large null component and eight isolated maps gives a concrete boundary for unsubdivided finite approximation.
